Title: EVT-OP-018: Asymptotic tail independence of block maxima in the Bai–Kulik–Wang model
Labels: open-problem, area:dependence, type:research, difficulty:hard, status:research

**Status in the survey:** A stated belief in the source. Specific to the stable-regenerative double-stable model, which the library does not have; the survey rates it out of reach.

## Source and quote
Bai, Kulik and Wang, arXiv:2409.17966v2, end of §1.3:

> in the presence of asymptotic tail independence of block maxima, which we believe to hold when $\log d_{n}/\log n\to 1$ and $d_{n}=o(n)$

The quote was extracted from the source text, with symbols flattened; check it against the published version before citing.

## Why it matters
It would complete the mesoscopic picture of that model.

## What the library already has
Leadbetter's theorem, the block condition and the extremal-index API, none for this model.

## What is missing
The stable-regenerative model itself.

## Pointers
`docs/PRACTICAL_OPEN_PROBLEMS.md`, §0, question 5. Survey feasibility estimates are unchecked plans, not results.
